changeSet.author: Core
changeSet.sql:
IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion') BEGIN CREATE TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion]( [Uid] [uniqueidentifier] NOT NULL, [EffectiveDate] [date] NOT NULL, [Weight] [decimal](5, 3) NOT NULL, [ConditionAndOr] [varchar](1) NULL, [Internal] [bit] CONSTRAINT [DF_MetricAssetVersion_Internal] DEFAULT (0) NOT NULL, [MetricRuleUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL, [CreatedOn] [datetime] NULL, [CreatedBy] [int] NULL, CONSTRAINT [PK_MetricAssetVersion] PRIMARY KEY NONCLUSTERED ( [Uid] ASC, [EffectiveDate] DESC ) ) END
IF NOT EXISTS (select * from sys.foreign_keys where name = 'FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] WITH CHECK ADD CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset] FOREIGN KEY([Uid]) REFERENCES [metrics].[Asset] ([Uid]) ON DELETE CASCADE ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] CHECK CONSTRAINT [FK_MetricAssetVersion_MetricAsset]
END

changeSet.author: BHoward
changeSet.sql: IF COL_LENGTH('[metrics].[AssetVersion]', 'EffectiveEndDate') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE metrics.assetVersion ADD EffectiveEndDate date NULL END IF COL_LENGTH('[metrics].[AssetVersion]', 'State') IS NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE metrics.assetVersion ADD [State] int END
changeSet.rollback: IF COL_LENGTH('[metrics].[AssetVersion]', 'EffectiveEndDate') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE metrics.assetVersion DROP COLUMN EffectiveEndDate END IF COL_LENGTH('[metrics].[AssetVersion]', 'State') IS NOT NULL BEGIN ALTER TABLE metrics.assetVersion DROP COLUMN [State] END

changeSet.author: BHoward
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE metrics.assetVersion SET [State] = 1
UPDATE metrics.assetVersion SET EffectiveEndDate = convert(varchar(10), getdate()-1, 120), [State] = 3 WHERE Uid in (SELECT Uid FROM metrics.Asset WHERE State = 3)

changeSet.sql: IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'MetricRuleUid') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] DROP COLUMN [MetricRuleUid] END
changeSet.rollback: IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT * FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = 'metrics' AND TABLE_NAME = 'AssetVersion' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'MetricRuleUid') BEGIN ALTER TABLE [metrics].[AssetVersion] ADD [MetricRuleUid] [uniqueidentifier] NULL END
